title: CaptureOntologyRelease
description: Capture one committed working revision as an immutable ontology release candidate.

expectedActivationRevision.description: Optional activation revision observed with the working diff.

expectedLatestReleaseRevision.description: Latest release revision observed by the caller. Required when versionBump is supplied.

versionBump.description: Allocate the next semantic version from the latest versioned candidate, including rejected candidates. The unversioned base is 0.0.0.
